summary: Nick Creadon, 31, of Golden fell an unknown distance glissading a snowy chute on Gabletop Mountain above Loomis Lake; rangers reached him after midnight, lowered him 500 ft by rope and assisted him 700 ft to Loomis Lake; flown to Upper Beaver Meadows Road then Flight for Life to St. Anthony Hospital.
location: Gabletop Mountain above Loomis Lake, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue | Flight for Life
notes: Incident began Friday afternoon; rangers reached him shortly after midnight Saturday; NPS update confirms he was reached early Saturday July 26, 2014, so occurrence date 2014-07-25. Steep cirque ~11,300 ft; ambulatory with life-threatening injuries; park paramedic ALS on scene; flown ~8:30 a.m. Same article mentions an unidentified climber's body found Friday below The Ledges on the Longs Peak Keyhole Route approach - separate incident not yet researched.
